description: This file handles server-side logic for the 'New Invoice' page in a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function to fetch and prepare data for rendering the invoice creation form, and an action to handle form submission for creating new invoices via API requests.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches organization, accounts, contacts, and invoice templates data, processes them, and returns structured data for the page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new invoice, validating input, parsing line items, and sending data via API.

calls: apiRequest('/invoices/', { method: 'POST', body: invoiceData }, { cookies, org: locals.org })
